items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of beach bonfire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated and presumably posted 18.11.2026. Letter itself states the 4-day delivery fiction (§110 Abs.2 LVwG): posting day 18.11.2026 + 4 calendar days = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday). This is a general authority (Ordnungsamt), not a tax office, so the delivery day does NOT move to the next working day even though it falls on a Sunday (per the rule distinguishing tax offices from other authorities). Delivery (Bekanntgabe) therefore occurs on 22.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§70 VwGO / general Widerspruch rule) runs from that delivery day under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 22.12.2026. Checking 22.12.2026: it is a Tuesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further adjustment under §193 BGB/§31 Abs.3 VwVfG/§108 Abs.3 AO analogue is needed. Final deadline: 22.12.2026.
